author: payAgain
changelog:
- Build a hash-pinned compiler-only TypeScript distribution instead of shipping Node system loading, language/server services and optional Node instrumentation.
- Retain the real semantic checker, upstream transpilation and unchanged diagnostics as readable JSON data; generated React remains isolated from Node.
- Add fail-closed source-shape/hash checks, executable-loader AST audits, restricted API checks and parity regressions against full TypeScript.
- Keep previous release tags/packages immutable. Marketplace and native evidence are tracked separately.

agentTools.description: Create a Canvas and select it for the right-side PI Canvas view. Read the Canvas skill/SDK; single-file TSX imports only @codex-canvas/sdk. Inspect ok, diagnostics and presentation. Never opens a detached window; the public host cannot automatically reveal the view.
agentTools.name: canvas_publish

agentTools.description: Update an explicitly identified canvas after canvas_read with its latest sourceRevision as baseRevision. Failed compilation preserves the latest successful view. Selects the canvas for the right-side view and binds this tool's host session; never opens a detached window.
agentTools.name: canvas_update

agentTools.description: Select an explicit saved canvas for the right-side PI Canvas view; binds the host-provided session, never an inferred chat. The view must be opened from the work-panel menu; no detached-window fallback.
agentTools.name: canvas_open

agentTools.description: Import/open a Canvas TSX/JSX inside the current PI workspace through host-scoped file permissions. path may be workspace-relative or absolute within that workspace; watch defaults true. Does not rewrite the external file.
agentTools.name: canvas_open_file

agentTools.description: Read current source, manifest, state and optional historical source revision. Read before editing; DOM paths are not AST selectors.
agentTools.name: canvas_read

agentTools.description: List the local PI Canvas library and plugin runtimeVersion. deleted=true lists recoverable deleted canvases. Does not read chat messages or open a panel.
agentTools.name: canvas_list

agentTools.description: Read connected native surfaces and recent trusted-shell rendering reports for an explicit canvas. A fresh ready heartbeat reports iframe readiness, not screenshot/visual quality evidence. Does not open a panel or send messages.
agentTools.name: canvas_status

agentTools.description: Move one explicitly requested canvas into the recoverable deleted list. Requires current sourceRevision as baseRevision. Never deletes external source files.
agentTools.name: canvas_delete

agentTools.description: Restore one explicitly identified deleted canvas, preserving source history and interaction state.
agentTools.name: canvas_restore

agentTools.description: Select the right-side PI Canvas capability view. If it is not already open, choose PI Canvas in the work-panel view menu. Never opens a detached window or sends a chat message.
agentTools.name: canvas_probe

en.name: PI Canvas
en.description: Right-side local Canvas for PI-Desktop with isolated React views, versioned source and persistent state.
en.safetyNotes: Trusted backend uses Node for its private library and packaged assets. Project TSX/JSX reads use host permissions. Generated views run in script-only sandbox iframes with no network or same-origin access. No chat reads, draft edits or message sends in the default package. Clipboard writes require an explicit user action. Back up the library before uninstalling.
